notes:
• Faster scanning — less of each JPEG is read, colours are captured while thumbnails are made rather than in a second pass, and the folders you're looking at are sharpened first.
• Fixed: RAW files (PEF/DNG) that had been rotated or edited didn't render at all, and some showed a garbled preview pulled from the wrong place in the file.
• Fixed: a rotation or crop made while a scan was running could be undone by the scan.
• Fixed: a pending Picasa.ini could be buried by Photon's own sidecar before its albums and stars were imported.
• Fixed: transparent PNGs showed black where they should have been white; right-click now acts on the whole selection; and selecting a folder reaches the photos inside it.
• Smoother in use — the lightbox opens on the thumbnail instead of "Loading…", a held photo in the tray opens with a double-click, the map pans while you drop a pin, and folders with no photos are no longer re-listed on every launch.
• New: Settings → About can save a diagnostics bundle, so you can send numbers instead of describing a problem.
